row.title: spinoffs deployed with retired-account secrets for 4 days (SPINOFF-DEPLOY-2)
row.body: spinoff.yml ran wrangler with CLOUDFLARE_* repo secrets (retired account) and a D1 id that only exists there; it failed daily from 2026-11-21 and the live worker kept serving retired apps. ultrastable-spinoffs is now in doctrine/topology.json, deploys through deploy-oidc.mjs, and deploy-ultrastable watches spinoffs/**. The uiux live audit reads retirement from spinoffs/registry.json.
